obligations.ask: Attend the appointment about your council tax account

results.segment: This letter confirms your appointment about your council tax account with Kelsford Borough Council on 4 May 2026 at 3.50pm.
Please arrive ten minutes early and bring this letter with you.
If you can no longer attend, our reception team will be glad to offer the time to somebody else.
The £5.00 monthly discount has been applied and will continue for 12 months.
